options.name: config
options.description: The profile configuration. Top-level keys are section names (C(Match), C(Network), C(NetDev) ...) and are written verbatim - casing matters. Values may be scalars (string, int, bool) or lists of scalars. List values are expanded to repeated C(Key=Value) lines as required by systemd-networkd (e.g. multiple C(DNS) entries). Booleans are rendered lower-case (C(true)/C(false)). C(None)/null values are skipped, allowing optional placeholders.

options.name: description
options.description: Free-form header placed at the top of the file. Lines without a leading C(#) are auto-prefixed so the result is always a valid comment block.

options.name: directory
options.description: Target directory where profile files are written.

options.name: mode
options.description: File mode of the resulting profile (octal string).

options.name: name
options.description: Base name of the profile file (without extension). Must not contain path separators.

options.name: profile_type
options.description: Type of profile. Selects the file extension appended to C(name).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the profile should exist (C(present)) or not (C(absent)).
